about.title: A modern platform for growth, execution and connection.
about.lead: Sura New International is a privately driven business development and investment platform built around one principle: strong opportunities become stronger when strategy, people, capital and execution move together.
about.text: We work across development, engineering, construction, interiors, furniture, procurement and operations — while connecting local market knowledge with international capabilities and long-term partnerships.
about.quote: Think strategically. Build locally. Connect globally.

1.title: Business Development & Investment
1.text: Opportunity identification, market entry, investment structures, commercial strategy and strategic growth.

2.title: Project Development
2.text: From concept definition and feasibility to development strategy, stakeholder alignment and delivery planning.

3.title: Engineering & Construction
3.text: General contracting, civil and structural works, building execution and engineering coordination.

4.title: Interior Fit-Out
4.text: Architectural finishes, joinery, specialist packages and integrated interior delivery.

5.title: Furniture & FF&E
5.text: Furniture sourcing, manufacturing coordination, supply, installation and complete FF&E packages.

6.title: MEP & Building Services
6.text: Mechanical, electrical, plumbing, firefighting, ELV, BMS and integrated building systems.

7.title: Operations & Maintenance
7.text: Facility management, technical maintenance, asset care, lifecycle planning and performance improvement.

8.title: Procurement & Supply
8.text: International sourcing, supplier coordination, logistics support and project procurement.
